query_analysis.original_query: Our vacuum distillation unit is showing signs of fouling. What predictive maintenance strategies can help mitigate long-term performance degradation?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Identify and recommend predictive maintenance strategies for a vacuum distillation unit experiencing fouling issues, aiming to prevent long-term performance decline.

selected_agents.role: Fouling analysis and root cause identification
Process monitoring and control strategy development

communication_strategy.information_flow: Root cause analysis and maintenance strategy formulation

clarification_questions: What specific signs of fouling have been observed in the vacuum distillation unit?
Are there any historical maintenance records indicating previous issues with the unit?
What are the current performance metrics of the distillation unit, and how have they changed over time?
